pairing.localHelp: Click Pair to discover Motrix on this computer and enter its pairing code.
pairing.remoteHelp: Click Pair, confirm the request in the Server operator UI, then enter the displayed code here. Both WS and WSS endpoints are supported; WSS is recommended.
pairing.serverRequiredHelp: Firefox for Android connects through Motrix Server. Add a Server above, then select it to pair.
pairing.remoteConsentBody: Remote downloads send the target URL, source page URL and title, filename, selection, and task controls to this Server. Cookies and request headers stay off unless enabled separately.
pairing.remoteConsentOffline: Data permissions are bound to the authenticated Server. Connect before changing them.
pairing.remoteHeadersHelp: Allows page-derived headers such as Referer and media playback headers. Authentication headers still require the credential permission below.
pairing.remoteCredentialsHelp: Allows cookies and credential headers for this Server only. Enable only for a Server you control.
pairing.pairedHelp: A committed MBP1 credential is retained for this backend. Current connection status is shown separately.
pairing.scopedHelp: Pairing trust and credentials are isolated for every backend. Switching backends never reuses another backend's trust.

servers.deleteActiveDescription: Delete {{name}} and its locally stored pairing credentials and consent? The current backend will fall back to Motrix App without connecting to or launching it.
servers.deleteActiveServerOnlyDescription: Delete {{name}} and its locally stored pairing credentials and consent? You will need to add or select another Motrix Server before downloading.
servers.deleteDescription: Delete {{name}} and its locally stored pairing credentials and consent? This does not revoke anything on the server.
servers.description: Save multiple Motrix Server addresses and switch between them from Options or the popup.
servers.dialogDescription: Name this backend and enter its WebSocket base URL.
servers.emptyDescription: Add a server to connect to Motrix beyond this computer.
servers.footer: Changing a server address requires pairing again. Pairing information is never shared between addresses.
servers.statusTransportSecure: Connection security: WSS is in use and TLS verifies the server identity
servers.statusTransportPlain: Connection security: encrypted, but WS cannot verify the server identity and may expose connection information. WSS is recommended
servers.title: Motrix Servers
servers.urlDescription: Use a ws:// or wss:// base URL. An optional path is kept as an exact reverse-proxy prefix; WSS is recommended.
servers.urlDuplicate: This Motrix Server address is already saved
servers.urlInvalid: Enter a valid ws:// or wss:// base URL without whitespace, credentials, query, or fragment
servers.transportWarningTitle: This connection does not use WSS
servers.transportWarningBody: Content exchanged with Motrix is still encrypted, but WS cannot verify the server identity and may expose connection information. Use WSS if your NAS supports it.

takeover.consentBody: Motrix receives the site's login cookies to download files. Sensitive sites stay in the browser.

takeover.title: Download takeover
takeover.remoteUnavailable: Automatic takeover currently requires the local Motrix App. Remote downloads and header or cookie permissions do not enable it. You can still send downloads to this Server manually or from the right-click menu.
takeover.availabilityUnknown: Takeover is unavailable until the selected backend can be checked.
takeover.remoteUnavailableShort: Local App only. Right-click sending works with Servers.
takeover.pairingRequiredBody: Pair at least one Motrix App or Server before enabling download takeover.

connection.backoffLocked: Too many pairing attempts. Try again later.
connection.staleAttempt: A newer connection attempt took over.
connection.deadlineExceeded: The attempt timed out. Try again.
connection.runsExhausted: Too many incorrect codes. Start pairing again for a fresh code.
connection.invalidCode: The code isn't in the expected format. Check the Motrix dialog.
connection.missingNonce: Motrix didn't offer a pairing slot. Make sure Motrix is running, then try again.
connection.unsupportedBrowser: Pairing isn't supported in this browser.
connection.ticketPreparationFailed: Pairing couldn't be prepared. Try again.
connection.protocolViolation: Motrix sent an unexpected response. Try again.
connection.unsupportedVersion: This extension and Motrix use different protocol versions. Update both and try again.
connection.backendUpgradeRequired: This Motrix version is too old for secure pairing. Update Motrix, then try again.
connection.extensionUpgradeRequired: This extension version is too old for this Motrix. Update the Motrix extension, then try again.
connection.unsupportedRemote: The authenticated Motrix is not the App or Server selected for this connection. Check the endpoint and try again.
connection.remoteDiscoveryUnavailable: The remote Motrix Server could not be reached. Check its address, listener, and network; for WSS, also check the certificate and reverse proxy.
connection.remotePairingUnavailable: The remote Motrix Server could not open a secure pairing session. Try again shortly.
connection.remoteTransportUnavailable: The remote Motrix Server connection failed. Check its address, listener, DNS, and network; for WSS, also check the certificate and reverse proxy. The browser cannot identify which one failed.
connection.peerBusy: Motrix is handling too many pairing requests. Try again shortly.
connection.securityCheckFailed: The connection failed a security check and was stopped.
connection.peerNotAuthentic: The other side couldn't prove it is your Motrix. The connection was stopped.
connection.credentialPhaseFailed: The pairing couldn't be saved. Try pairing again.
connection.internalError: Something went wrong in the extension. Try again.
connection.authFailed: Motrix didn't recognize this pairing. It may have been revoked — try pairing again.
connection.serverMacMismatch: The reply failed verification, so the connection was stopped. It may not be your Motrix.
connection.channelClosed: The connection was closed. Reconnect to continue.
connection.channelUnavailable: Motrix isn't reachable right now. Make sure it's running.
connection.storedPairingUnavailable: Couldn’t connect to Motrix. Open it and try again; your saved pairing is retained.
